contexts.text: The earth is the containant of the soil, and the soil is the containant of the field, as love is the containant of faith, and faith is the containant of the Knowledges of faith which are inseminated.
There is a certain general by which they are kept together... but the general which keeps them together is the worship of self.
The man wondering at her kept still () = a state of perception as to these things. Explained.
Nothing can be held together in a form except by something else... The human body is held together in form by the atmospheres...
The cup is the containant, and the wine is what is contained... thus the one is meant by the other.
Baskets represented containants, and the things in them, the contents.
He supposes that exterior cohere with interior things continuously.
Scientifics are the containants of natural good, as ears are of corn.
He refrained himself () = concealment.
Joseph could not refrain himself to all who were standing with him () = that now all things were prepared for conjunction by the celestial internal.
Truths are the contents, and the Natural is the containant; wherefore, in the internal sense, the containant is now signified, and now the thing contained, according to the series of things.

All scientifics and truths... must be placed and contained in a general... The most general universal by which all things are held together is the Lord Himself, and that which holds them together is the Divine truth proceeding from Him... The more general Societies are those to which correspond the members, organs, and viscera in man, which by a wonderful connection are in such a form, that they mutually regard each other, and thus mutually hold each other together... In man, the most general universal which holds together the individual things, is the soul, and also is the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord; for this continually flows in...
The Natural is what contains, and scientifics are the things contained, hence Egypt = both the containant and the thing contained, that is, both the Natural and what is scientific.
Thus are successives held together in their own order and connection.
Contained in this verse...
Pot = a containant of good, and, in the opposite sense, a containant of evil. Explained... The Corporeal and the Natural of man are the containants of good or of evil...
Good therein, as much as it may contain. Signified.
The containant takes this signification from the thing contained.
The external truths and goods by which they are held together. Signified.
All external things hold together internal ones...

Divine good conjoined with Divine truth, which is the ultimate, terminant, concludent, and containant of Heaven, is like the atmosphere... which holds together the whole surface of the body in its connection.
That which is outermost not only holds together the interior things...
What is external holds together all interior things in their own order, and in their form and connection...
In proportion as doing contains in it what man thinks and wills, interior things are held together in their form and connection...
The external colligament by which all things are held together in connection and form. Signified.
Those things which are lowest, or ultimate, hold together the higher or interior things in connection and in form.

The altar has a similar signification to that which is upon it, for the altar is the containant, and that which is upon it is the thing contained, and the containant and the thing contained make one thing, as the table and the bread which is upon it, the cup and the wine which is in it.
The Lord Himself flows in with every man according to the form of Heaven... and thus holds together in connection each and all things with him...
Deeds or works contain in themselves all things of man's love and faith.
The Lord rules the primes and ultimates of order, primes from ultimates, and ultimates from primes, and thus holds all things together in connection and in order. References.
Under Basis, see these references. DSS 34. DLW 209. DLW 212. DLW 213. DLW 221.
Hence the sense of the letter is the containant.
The roof and walls, which are its containants...
Being reagents, they are containants.
Under Atmosphere, see this reference, and at DLW 183. DLW 296. DLW 299. DLW 316:4.
As spiritual heat is the containant of love, and spiritual light the containant of wisdom...
The Natural is the containing ultimate.
As the natural mind is the covering and the containant of the higher degrees of the human mind, it is a reagent...
It follows that use is the containant of wisdom and of love. DLW 299.
After death, man retains the purer things of nature which are nearest to spiritual things, and these are then his containants.
In the Word, the containant = the same as the thing contained... AR 406. AR 672.
The earth which was adjacent to me.
Upon this adjacent earth...
The whole Heaven is nothing but a containant of uses from primes to ultimates: what is use but the actual love of the neighbour? and what holds the Heavens together but this love?
The things which proceed from the sun of the world are the containants of life, and are called natural things.
Man is withheld from evil and kept in good by the Lord.
The Holy Supper universally and singularly contains all things of the Church, and all things of Heaven. General article.
The Lord is Divine love and Divine wisdom... the human form is their containant.
This now continually for many years.
Broken cisterns, that can hold no waters () = doctrinal things from their Own intelligence in which there are no truths. AE 537:13.
